column3: NKJV renders “what I will answer concerning my complaint” as “what I will answer when I am corrected.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “it pants (hastens) to the end” is rendered “at the end it will speak.”
NKJV renders “behold, it is swollen” as “Behold the proud,” and “by his faithfulness” as “by his faith.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wine is treacherous, an arrogant man” is rendered “because he transgresses by wine, He is a proud man,” “his throat” “his desire,” and “Sheol” “hell.”
Close to the Hebrew; “pledges” is rendered “many pledges.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who bite you (charge interest)” is rendered “your creditors,” and “those who make you tremble” “who oppress you.”

Close to the Hebrew; “who gains evil gain” is rendered “who covets evil gain,” and “the hand of harm” “the power of disaster.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you have planned shame” is rendered “You give shameful counsel,” and “sinned [against] your soul” “sin against your soul.”

NKJV renders “pouring out your rage” as “Pressing him to your bottle” (the Hebrew word can mean “wrath” or “wineskin”).
Close to the Hebrew; “be counted as uncircumcised” is rendered “be exposed as uncircumcised,” and “disgrace” “utter shame.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the devastation of beasts will terrify them” is rendered “the plunder of beasts which made them afraid.”
